name: Posts from an article
description: Picks the ideas worth sharing, writes a LinkedIn post and short posts at the same time, checks them against the article, then waits for your OK.

steps.prompt:
Read this article and pick the three ideas a reader would want to share, each in one sentence, with the line of the article it comes from:
{{brief}}

Write a LinkedIn post from these ideas: at most 1,200 characters, a first line that makes people stop, three hashtags at most.

{{step 1}}

Write three short posts for X or Bluesky from these ideas, each under 280 characters, each one clear on its own.

{{step 1}}
Is every post true to the article? Is anything claimed that the article does not say? Is each one clear without the article?
Read the posts before they are used.
